verdicts.reason: A centres the headline and tagline on both axes at a strong size and keeps the cream/gold/orange colours, with a tight, deliberate stack; the gap between the tagline and the bottom edge is a little tight. B pushes the block left of centre and up against the top, leaving a dead band at the bottom and a big empty right side, and its type is smaller than it needs to be.

A has the same off-centre, top-heavy placement: the text sits left of the axis with empty space below and to the right. B is centred horizontally and vertically with balanced margins and clear hierarchy; its type could be a bit larger for the banner, and the headline-to-tagline gap is slightly loose.

A is again shifted left and up, with lopsided dead space at the bottom and right. B uses larger, more legible type, is vertically centred and fills the height well, but the block still sits left of centre and leaves about 150px empty on the right, which looks unintended rather than a deliberate left-aligned grid.
